messages:
noah_finance: Reseller dispute: AWS Marketplace invoice charged for Metered SKU 'compute-hour-plus' for 14,000 units but partner dashboard reports 11,200 and many events tagged as 'internal-test'. Need quick audit.

amy_partners: do we have invoice id and reseller id?

noah_finance: invoice INV-2026-06-12-reseller-99, reseller: channel-zenith. Billing snapshot was 2026-06-01T00:00Z. Partner export attached below (redacted).

ingest-bot: Invoice INV-2026-06-12-reseller-99 created for $28,000 (14,000 units @ $2.00). Billing period: 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-30.

chris_billing: paste of partner CSV (trimmed):
2026-05-31T23:59:58Z,res-99,compute-hour-plus:8000,tag:production
2026-06-02T02:12:10Z,res-99,compute-hour-plus:+3200,tag:internal-test
2026-06-05T11:45:00Z,res-99,compute-hour-plus:+1200,tag:production
2026-06-10T16:20:00Z,res-99,compute-hour-plus:+2400,tag:internal-test

chris_billing: looks like meterlines include test-tagged usage that partner says should be excluded from billing. Why did invoicing pipeline include them?

amy_partners: Partner ops says they used a temporary SKU mapping during a migration; test traffic was mistakenly tagged with the production SKU. They provided a clean export removing test-tagged rows.

noah_finance: finance policy: we don't bill internal-test unless explicit waiver. We need to issue a credit for the test-tagged units that were billed. Quick calc: test units = 3200 + 2400 = 5600 units => $11,200 credit.

chris_billing: created ticket TCK-5110: "AWS Marketplace SKU tagging mismatch - channel-zenith" assigned to eng-ops. Also note: ingestion pipeline should respect event.tag when mapping SKUs.

ingest-bot: Noted. Suggested mitigation: add a pre-snapshot filter to exclude events with tag==internal-test unless flagged for billing.

amy_partners: reseller accepts credit and requests a short memo for their accounts. Laura from AR will you handle the credit memo? (cc: laura_ar).

noah_finance: laura_ar looped in. Provisional credit approved up to $12k. AP hold payment until memo attached to TCK-5110.

chris_billing: will prioritize a quick hotfix to ignore test-tagged events during snapshot. Also adding a guard to warn when >10% of snapshoted units have test tag.

amy_partners: thanks team. reseller wants the credit applied before their quarter close. Can we target EOD tomorrow?

noah_finance: EOD tomorrow goal accepted. I'll prepare memo and update TCK-5110 when done. :hourglass:

chris_billing: thanks all :thumbsup:
